verified_facts.text: The hotel is at 377 Greenwich Street, New York NY 10013.

verified_facts.text: No two of the hotel's guest rooms and suites are alike.
verified_facts.excerpt: uniquely appointed guest rooms and suites, of which no two are alike.

verified_facts.text: The Courtyard King has French doors with a Juliet balcony opening onto the hotel's inner courtyard.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Courtyard King features French doors with a Juliet balcony that opens onto the hotel’s serene inner courtyard.

verified_facts.text: Rooms are individually designed with custom furnishings, Siberian oak floors and handwoven rugs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each, individually designed with custom furnishings, Siberian oak floors, and handwoven rugs.

verified_facts.text: The Fireplace Corner Suite has a living room with a stone fireplace and floor-to-ceiling Hudson River views.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Fireplace Corner Suite features a living room with stone fireplace, wet bar, working desk, and dining area with floor to ceiling Hudson River views and separate bedroom.

verified_facts.text: The Greenwich Duplex has 30-foot atelier windows in the living room, a brick fireplace, a kitchen and a lofted office.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Greenwich Duplex features soaring 30 ft. atelier windows in the living room, with a brick fireplace, dining area, kitchen, and a lofted office space

verified_facts.text: The TriBeCa Penthouse occupies the top two floors, created by designer Axel Vervoort and architect Tatsuro Miki using the Japanese aesthetic of wabi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Occupying the top two floors of The Greenwich hotel, Designer Axel Vervoort and architect Tatsuro Miki utilized the ancient Japanese aesthetic sense of wabi to create this meditative haven.

verified_facts.text: All stays include a house car for short trips within downtown NYC, on availability.
verified_facts.excerpt: House car for short trips within downtown NYC on availability

verified_facts.text: All stays include minibar snacks, water and soft drinks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minibar snacks, water, and soft drinks

verified_facts.text: All stays include domestic and international phone calls.
verified_facts.excerpt: Domestic and International phone calls

verified_facts.text: An extra twin bed or crib is available on request in advance.

verified_facts.text: Well-behaved dogs and cats are welcome.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes. Well-behaved dogs and cats are welcome.

verified_facts.text: There is no additional fee or size limit for pets, but owners must sign a waiver at check-in.
verified_facts.excerpt: While there is no additional fee or size limitation to pets welcome at the hotel, a waiver is required to be signed upon check in by their responsible owners.

verified_facts.text: Pets on leash are welcome in the Drawing Room, Courtyard and Lobby.
verified_facts.excerpt: pets are welcome to enjoy the hotel’s Drawing Room, Courtyard, and Lobby areas on leash.

verified_facts.text: Pets should not be left unattended in guest rooms.

verified_facts.text: Hudson River Park is a 5-minute walk from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has specially adapted guest rooms that comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Greenwich Hotel offers public spaces and specially-adapted guest rooms, which are in full compliance with the American Disabilities Act.

verified_facts.text: The hotel opened in Tribeca in April 2008.

verified_facts.text: Actor Robert De Niro, who grew up nearby, is one of the owners.

verified_facts.text: Original paintings by Robert De Niro Sr. hang on the hotel's walls.

verified_facts.text: The exterior is hand-made Pennsylvanian brick topped with cast bronze medallions based on historic New York manhole cover designs.
verified_facts.excerpt: The exteriors are done in hand-made Pennsylvanian brick, garnished with custom cast bronze medallions—based on historic New York City manhole cover designs—atop the building’s crown.

verified_facts.text: The lobby floors were modeled on the terra-cotta flooring of a 14th-century Italian palazzo.
verified_facts.excerpt: the lobby floors were modeled after the terra-cotta flooring in a 14th-century Italian palazzo.

verified_facts.text: The Shibui Spa is framed under the roof of a 250-year-old wood and bamboo farmhouse reconstructed in the hotel by Japanese craftsmen.

verified_facts.text: The Shibui Spa takes its cue from Japanese bathing rituals.
